content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not rest an UNDERDETERMINED label on the fact that a single verse fails to state a link or its contrary; it rests it on the defender having dropped the curse limb.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"none","why":"The stated ground is the dropped live link, not a single verse's failure to state the link or its contrary."}
